answer: Gate entry on a scarce resource the farm cannot manufacture in parallel: proof-of-personhood hardware that is physically unclonable, so fifty clones still need fifty devices bought at retail. Each island of identities must also survive a canyon of periodic re-attestation, where a randomly chosen stranger verifies the device in live interaction; a velvet lobby of mutual vouching inside one cluster earns nothing because quorum weight is discounted by shared answers. Adding a head thus costs new hardware plus unshared live attention, and costs scale faster than head count.
